title: Robotics Software Engineer (Junior)
description:
Marlowe Robotics makes small autonomous carts for hospital logistics. The software team writes the navigation and the fleet tools.

As a junior engineer you will write ROS nodes in C++ and Python, test them in simulation, and help us run the carts on the ward at night.

We ask for
- A degree in computer science, robotics or a close field, or equal work.
- Some experience with ROS, even from a university project.
- C++ or Python.

0 to 2 years of work experience. We will teach you the rest. We help with the work permit and the move.
